name: Meleager's Boar-Spear
lore: The ash-shafted spear with which Meleager pinned the Calydonian Boar that Artemis sent in vengeance for a forgotten sacrifice. His mother carried a brand from his birth-fire; when he killed her brothers over Atalanta's prize, she threw it on the hearth, and the hero burned with it. The spear was a king's weapon either way.
curve_note: base_damage = curve.weapon_base_damage(26) x 1.8 unique-mult, rounded. Class: heavy 5-rung [0.75, 0.90, 1.00, 1.30, 1.75]. F20-29 Asterion-era band fill.
